fact: As of October 2023 the National Tourism Office's information system was deployed and operated under an infogérance contract by the private firm e-COM SAS, with arrears above USD 1.5 million endangering its upkeep.
title: Insolvabilité de l'ONT vis-à-vis de e-COM SAS : le ministre Mazenga bloquerait le dossier, exigeant des rétrocommissions
